text: World War II ended in 1945. The war in Europe ended in May 1945 (Germany's surrender on May 8, known as V-E Day), while the war in the Pacific ended in August/September 1945 after Japan's surrender following the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki and the Soviet declaration of war against Japan. Japan's formal surrender ceremony took place on September 2, 1945, aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay.
